heading: Regulations

tree.heading: Requirement
tree.text: The Director shall prescribe in regulations appropriate procedures to carry out this subchapter. Such regulations shall be prescribed in consultation with the Director of the Office of Personnel Management and the Executive Director of the Federal Retirement Thrift Investment Board.

tree.heading: Congressional review
tree.text: The Director shall submit regulations prescribed under subsection (a) to the congressional intelligence committees before they take effect.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 306 of Pub. L. 88–643, as added Pub. L. 99–335, title V, § 506, June 6, 1986, 100 Stat. 628, related to regulations and was set out as a note under section 403 of this title prior to the general amendment of Pub. L. 88–643 by section 802 of Pub. L. 102–496.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective on first day of fourth month beginning after Oct. 24, 1992, see section 805 of Pub. L. 102–496, set out as a note under section 2001 of this title.

sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 88–643, title III, § 306, as added Pub. L. 102–496, title VIII, § 802, Oct. 24, 1992, 106 Stat. 3251.)
